NewsArticle.Title: Server Reboot
NewsArticle.Content: - 08.20 20:16 PDT - 08.20 22:51 PDT A Dark Ages server rebooted unexpectedly due to a software error. Service resumed immediately. The faulty code was isolated within 3 minutes of the reboot. At all other times all Dark Ages servers are stable. The Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load.
